article::ὁ::nominative.masculine.singula.reasoning: The sentence carries no other article form, so ὁ has nothing to compete with. Without it, ἔσχατος could be read as a predicate ('he came last'). With ὁ it becomes the substantive subject, 'the last one', which frames the whole scene. The fronted οὐδὲ ἕνα ἄρτον gives the late arrival his rhetorical sting inside a single main clause with one temporal participle.
article::ὁ::nominative.masculine.singula.sentence: ὁ ἔσχατος ἐλθὼν οὐδὲ ἕνα ἄρτον εὗρεν.
article::ὁ::nominative.masculine.singula.translation: The last one, when he arrived, found not even one loaf of bread.
